{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor pads''' were platforms that were suspended above the ground using [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift engines]]. A section of a hidden [[Imperial communications outpost]]'s landing platform on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] was configured as a repulsor pad to allow it to be lowered to recover [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] and [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repuslorcraft]].<ref name="Remnant">{{WEGCite|story=Remnants of the Empire (adventure)|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)}}</ref> Repulsor pads were also used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seltos]] to allow residential homes to hover in the air, connected to the ground by open-air [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]]. [[Sinya Deboora]]'s home, [[12 Galactar Route]], was suspended ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in the air using repulsor pads.<ref name="Seltos">{{WEGCite|story=Freedom Strike Seltos (adventure)|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref> Low-power repulsor pads were fitted to the bottom of [[memory droid]]s to nullify the unit's substantial weight.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
